messages:
sophia: Heads-up: we need a design review to cover the new Query Planner API + SDK surface and the Console onboarding flow. Pre-read + checklist below. Who can suss out times this week? Prefer TZ-friendly windows 9am-3pm PT.

matt: Can we aim for Thu? I can do 10-11am PT. Agenda + read?

laura: I can only do afternoons PT after 1pm. Is 2pm PT ok?

sophia: Thanks — aiming to keep to 60m. Pre-read: PR + proto links: https://git.redwood/repo/qp-pr   proto: https://drive.redwood/qp-proto . Please skim code + sample flows.

nikhil: Will add a short perf summary; also flagging two ops constraints: cache invalidation and partial-rollouts.

james: Who should be the primary reviewer for SDK changes?

laura: Assigning @matt for SDK, @nikhil for runtime, @console-design for console UX. If someone else wants to co-review, say so.

matt: sg. I'll add brief diff notes to the PR. Ask: do we want a canary plan doc in the pre-read or put in follow-ups?

sophia: Include high-level canary plan in pre-read (one slide). We'll keep follow-ups for runbooks.

calendar-bot: Proposed times (automated poll): Thu 2/9 17:00 UTC (10am PT), Thu 19:00 UTC (12pm PT), Fri 20:00 UTC (1pm PT). Vote with :thumbsup: below.

laura: :thumbsup: on Thu 10am PT

matt: :thumbsup: Thu 10am PT

nikhil: :thumbsup: Fri 1pm PT (prefer contingency option)

sophia: Noted — tiebreaker: pick Thu 10am PT if majority. Agenda draft: 1) 10m context & goals; 2) 20m API + SDK diffs; 3) 15m Console onboarding UX; 4) 10m rollouts + SLO impact; 5) 5m action items.

james: Can we call out 'migration path' in API section? some customers will need gradual upgrades.

laura: Added. Also add a 'QA checklist' item under rollouts.

sophia: Pre-read checklist (copy-paste):

- [ ] Link to PR + branch
- [ ] Proto sketches + example payloads
- [ ] Migration plan (backwards compatibility)
- [ ] Canary plan + metrics to watch
- [ ] Perf numbers (p50/p95 token latency, throughput)
- [ ] Console mockups + flows
- [ ] Runbook owner assigned

Please update PR with the items you own before EOD Wed.

matt: Quick Q: do we want to include a small live demo? I can run a short SDK snippet if network allows.

sophia: Yes, demo would be great if it fits time. Put it in API+SDK slot and keep it to 5 minutes.

laura: I'll prep the console mocks and upload to the drive link.

nikhil: I'll surface perf numbers and a lightweight stress test script: `./scripts/stress_qp.sh --rps 200`

console-design: I'll be on for UX + accessibility notes. One ask: can we get sample customer persona to validate onboarding flow? @sophia can you share?

sophia: Good point — attaching persona doc: https://drive.redwood/personas/onboarding_customer.pdf

calendar-bot: Event tentatively booked: Thu 1766124010 (10:00 PT). Attendees: sophia, matt, laura, nikhil, james, console-design. Calendar invite sent.

james: Thanks — I'll do a quick walkthrough of migration examples live.

laura: If anything blocks pre-reads, ping me here. Otherwise, see you Thu.

sophia: :rocket: Great — linking action items into the PR now.
